transcript: There are five signs your body carries too much sugar, and if you ignore them, they slowly, quietly harm your health. I am Master Yang Mun, a humble Chinese healer with more than 40 years of experience. I have studied sugar, the blood and the quiet illnesses that grow inside the body for most of my life. Watch this video until the end, my friend. You may not find it again when your body needs it most. First sign, poor sleep. When you wake up in the middle of the night, around three in the morning, it means your body is not at peace. Your nerves overstimulated by high sugar in the blood. Second sign, constant thirst and many trips to the toilet. When your mouth is always dry and you run off into the bathroom, your kidneys are crying for help trying to push the sugar out. Third sign, strong craving for sweets and rice or bread. When sugar is too high, insulin cannot do its job, and your body keeps asking for more, more fuel, more sugar. Fourth sign, itching all over the body without reason. High sugar burns the small rivers, the tiny blood vessels beneath your skin. That's why your skin cries out with itch and discomfort. Fifth sign, body pain that never truly leaves. Too much sugar can damage your nerves, bringing constant aches and heaviness in your arms and legs. And if you wish to learn my ancient methods to balance the body and clean the blood sugar naturally, check my ebook. It's waiting for you in the link on my profile.
